notes.title: 50% off on Halloween Sale & v1.3 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35808451/8ea6a6efd377df68c5522485ed9e80f4e415eae5.png[/img]

Hey everyone,
I’ve made a number of improvements to Stratos as well as including a story mode. Hopefully it gives the player more direction!

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multi-stage storyline
[*] Characters and basic dialogue
[*] More side-quests
[*] World events the player can resolve, such as droughts & plagues
[*] Several more props
[*] Speech bubble conversations between crew
[*] Fixed some crew stats
[*] Expanded UI descriptions, including what the current weather is and the effects it has
[*] Fixed up the map: villages are evenly distributed
[*] V-Sync option
[/list]

notes.title: Small update v1.1.3
notes.notes:
I’ve made a small update to Stratos which should address some issues users have experienced. I’m working towards a Story Mode for v1.2.0, so this update contains a few pre-requisite features, such as Captaincy.

[h2]Captain[/h2]
[list]
[*] A member is designated a captain at the start of the game.
[*] Captaincy will pass to another if they perish in combat.
[*] Cosmetic actions – talking to islanders and using ship wheel.
[*] Crew quarters & captain’s desk prop
[/list]
[h2]Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Remove floating arrows
[*] Disabled UE4 VR plugin
[*] Clarified some text
[*] If a prop (chair, beds, etc…) is occupied, fire doesn’t destroy it
[*] Corrected gear when selecting “Old Soldier” background 
[*] Stop battle music if fleeing combat
[/list]
[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased Mineral node spawn chance
[*] ‘Crafting resource’ trader now in marketplace
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Hey all, thanks for your patience as I try sort out some bugs. Fingers crossed it was done properly, please let me know if you find any other issues!

[h2]Crew[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some crew standing still when injured
[*] Fixed injured crew not going to medical bay
[*] Fixed crew being stuck after dealing with a fire
[/list]
[h2]Props[/h2]
[list]
[*] Furnaces should toggle properly
[*] Fixed chairs some being immovable
[/list]
[h2]Ship[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with crafting being stuck when removing an item from the queue
[/list]
[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trader encounters no longer sell Gold
[*] UI clarified when accepting quest
[*] Marketplace purchase and price fixed
[/list]
[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]
[*] Switching camera to ship stops crew from teleporting back
[*] Backstory now saves correctly- unfortunately this will likely glitch any existing victory quests
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Addressed a bug I accidently introduced in version 1.1 that would stop eating & drinking. 
[*] Happiness doesn’t drop as much as it should.
[*] Corrected materials cost for new rooms
[/list]

I’ve been informed of a crafting issue, and building to a certain level, which I’ll be working on for the next update.

notes.title: Stratos Version 1.1 Launched!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35808451/35fc37d3d93d460b0e87d8914e5067d2fdaa110d.png[/img]

Hey all,
I’m happy to announce Stratos has just been updated to version 1.1!
Main features include the introduction of special abilities, found on weapons & armour.
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attach and defence of enemy units now scale with player level
[*] Enemy fortifications- can only be destroyed by cannons
[*] Obstacles – take up unit space in the arena
[*] Corrected Bow & Arrow animations
[/list]
[h2]Quests[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapons and armour are now quest rewards
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some room descriptions missing
[*] Crafting menu is better organized for navigation
[*] Inventory menu is now a list, showing names of items & stats
[*] Audio
[*] Included some missing sounds for combat FX
[*] Separate controls for Music, Master & SFX volume
[/list]
[h2]Gear[/h2]
[list]
[*] More weapons and armour
[*] Unlock new crafting recipes each player level up to 19
[*] Wands that feature strong magical abilities
[*] Charms that improve passive stats in combats
[/list]
[h2]Ship[/h2]
[list]
[*] Training Rooms – An Entertainment room that improves strength of crew members that visit it
[*] Crew
[*] Crew no longer level up by combat XP. Each Stat is improved by conducting various tasks or being equipped with certain weapons in combat.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.7 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35808451/4592098351def386adde2edb4caec6ca64d6933a.png[/img]

Hey all,

Version 0.7 is now live & fully accessible through the demo!

This version includes a re-fix of the UI, providing some clarity to buttons and menus.
NPC roles have been reduced and changed
[list]
[*] 	Crafting is based on a productivity value
[*] 	Food and water production is now hourly-based, depending on crew members assigned as Farmers
[*] 	Food has been shrunk to a single value
[*] 	Meals no longer required to be made
[*] 	Chefs are optional and provides bonus to food production
[*] 	Completing objectives now provides chest rewards
[/list]

notes.title: Azure Update 0.4.7 now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I’m happy to announce Azure version 0.4.7 is now live.

This update focuses on Steam Workshop integration- you can now design your own ships and material palettes and share them with others. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1890884431 

Unfortunately Steam doesn’t support access to the Workshop via the demo, so I’ll be looking for different sites to host the mods.

This update also includes some various bug-fixes and the start of a Codex to help inform the player of different features.
